title: Symptom Journal Missing-Day Risk
dataSources: Allergy symptoms (`allergy:entry`), migraine records (`migraine:entry`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), and sleep-talking events (`sleeptalk:event`).
app: Symptom telemetry for allergy diaries, migraine aura tracking, bathroom frequency logging, and sleep-talking review sent to Splunk HEC via apps and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allergy:entry
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by profile_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which profiless have gone quiet for symptom journaling.
value: A missing-day view helps catch the point where the journal stops being reliable before you try to learn from it.
implementation: Send symptom journaling events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of profiless with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which profiless have gone quiet longer than they should for symptom journaling.
